canonical_description: Simple ink-line stickman figure, rounded head, slim proportions (roughly 1:6 head-to-body ratio), soft watercolor-wash skin tone, plain warm-grey trousers and a muted teal sweater as the default outfit. No facial features beyond simple dot eyes and an expressive line mouth. Always drawn with clean, un-hatched line work — no pencil crosshatch shading.
character_anchor_text: The same recurring stickman narrator character: simple ink-line figure, rounded head, slim 1:6 head-to-body proportions, soft watercolor-wash skin tone, muted teal sweater and warm-grey trousers, simple dot eyes and expressive line mouth, clean un-hatched line work — keep identical proportions, palette, and facial simplicity in every scene.

outfit_variants.description: Adds a simple translucent rain slicker over the default teal sweater; proportions and palette otherwise unchanged.
